name: CUT3
tagline: CUT3 is an AI video editor you drive by chat
description: CUT3 is an AI video editor you drive by chat. Tell the agent what you want and it builds the edit: cuts synced to the beat, automatic subtitles, voiceover and voice cloning, background removal, and generated shots when you are missing footage. There is no timeline to drag — you keep refining in plain language until it is right, with live preview while it works.
